sentences: When a space rock enters Earth's **atmosphere**, most people think it simply burns up, but a new study shows that the real story is more complicated.
Scientists at the SETI Institute studied videos and photos of seventy-five meteorite falls and found that each rock goes through seven **stages**.
High in the sky, the air in front of the rock is pushed together so quickly that it forms a **shock wave**, and the rock and the hot gas around it begin to glow.
At around sixty kilometers above the ground, the rock **melts** from the outside, and this melting alone can remove up to forty percent of its original **mass**.
en.answer: 우주 암석이 지구 대기에 들어오면 대부분의 사람들은 그것이 그냥 다 타 버린다고 생각하지만, 새 연구는 실제 이야기가 더 복잡하다는 것을 보여 준다.
